people.name: Zoar
people.line: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction

translations.web: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
translations.bsb: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.” That is why the town was called Zoar.
translations.kjv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
translations.asv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
